findings.summary: SourceInfo construction still references the deleted `total_bitrate_mbps` binding instead of the new `video_bitrate_mbps`.
findings.mechanism: The diff renames/replaces the old `total_bitrate_mbps` computation with `video_bps`/`video_bitrate_mbps`, but line 340 (`video_bitrate_mbps: total_bitrate_mbps,`) was never updated. `total_bitrate_mbps` is no longer declared anywhere in scope, so this fails to compile (unresolved name) — the whole crate is broken by this change.
